scenes.title: Segment 1: The accusation and the stated reason
scenes.purpose: Establish whom Angela accuses, what she calls it, and the reason she gives for hosting her Space, while flagging that she says she has not listened to the Space she is reacting to.

blocks.note: Low bed under the opening, keep it thin.

blocks.text: Yeah, so. This one's awkward, man. I'm in it. Angela hosted a Space, and the question is pretty simple, right? What has she said about me. What she accuses me of, what she says she's holding, why she says she's doing it, and what she says comes next. I'm gonna play her in her own words, and I'll tell you what I can't verify. Which is, like, a lot.

blocks.keptText: This is gonna be like a monologue echo chamber space. This is just for the record. I'm not gonna go listen to your space, but I've been sent the clips and the recordings and play-by-plays and... Fuck you, Logan, and fuck you, Orr. You're trash for talking about my dead baby.
blocks.rationale: Her opening in her own voice: who she targets, and that she is reacting to clips rather than the Space itself.

blocks.text: I mean, first thing. She says she hasn't listened to my Space. She says she was sent material instead. So what was actually said in the Space with Orr, I don't know. Not from this recording, anyway. And yeah, she also tells everybody else to go listen. Which, okay.

claims.verbatim: I'm not gonna go listen to your space, but I've been sent the clips and the recordings and play-by-plays

blocks.text: Her reason, and she comes back to it a lot, is the comment about her dead baby. She says that's why she hosted. She says nobody asked her to. I'm just telling you what she says, you know? I don't know what was said in that room.

claims.verbatim: I only hosted this space because Logan had a space where Orr was in there and they were talking about my dead fucking baby.
Nobody is asking me to do it.

blocks.keptText: So that's pretty much what I want to address. Those are my allegations against Logan Black. Because he's apparently letting people talk shit about my dead baby. So this is my response.
blocks.rationale: She labels her own statement as allegations and says what triggered it.

blocks.keptText: I am doing this of my own free will, mind, body, and soul. Nobody is asking me to do it. And I am completely disgusted by the misogynistic predator behavior that is happening on this fucking app.
blocks.rationale: Her stated motive and the label she puts on the conduct she alleges.

blocks.text: So, misogynistic predator behavior. That's her phrase, and it's her allegation. I'm not gonna argue it here, I just wanna look at what she says she's got to back it up.

claims.verbatim: the misogynistic predator behavior that is happening on this fucking app

scenes.title: Segment 2: The evidence she says she holds
scenes.purpose: Lay out the evidence Angela claims to have (screenshots, a screen recording, DMs), where she says it came from, and why none of it can be verified from this recording.

blocks.note: Short shift into the more clinical, documentary tone.

blocks.text: Allegations are cheap. Evidence is not. So what does Angela say she holds? Screenshots. According to her, she posts them in batches, and she says she has more than she has shown.

claims.verbatim: We're gonna do it in increments of four.
These are the ones I'm choosing to post now. But I have the rest.

blocks.keptText: But we're gonna go through these. In order. Just to... To show this pattern of behavior. So scrolling down to the bottom. This is between Logan Black. And Sav. He told her to shut the fuck up.
blocks.rationale: The start of her reading of the screenshots, with the claimed parties named.

blocks.text: What follows is a long reading, message by message. Angela says these are exchanges between me and Sav. We hear her voice, not the messages themselves. Nothing in the recording authenticates them, and nothing puts them in context.

claims.verbatim: This is between Logan Black. And Sav.

blocks.keptText: And like you said, Logan, you're only posting the truth so that people can, you know, analyze for themselves. That's what you said in this one screenshot. So I'm doing the same.
blocks.rationale: Her stated justification for publishing the material.

blocks.text: Where did the material come from? Her answer is on the record.

blocks.keptText: Also, where do you think I'm getting this stuff from? Dumbass. People that are sitting with you that are too scared to confront you because you have dirt on them. So they sent it to me.
blocks.rationale: Her account of provenance; unnamed sources, unverified.

blocks.text: Unnamed senders. A claim that they are afraid of me. Neither can be checked here. She adds one more assurance: she says she screenshots in real time, so she can show where messages were changed. A fair point, if it holds. It has not been shown.

claims.verbatim: I screenshot in real time.

blocks.keptText: Now, Logan. Two days ago, that space with Larry was still on your page. Now, I know because I went back and we screen recorded it.
blocks.rationale: A second kind of evidence she claims: a screen recording of a Space she says was later removed.

blocks.text: She alleges that I went back to 2024 to delete that Space. She reads the deletion as a tell. In her words, quote, you erasing evidence is playing into my hand. But a deleted Space shows only that it is gone. Why it is gone, this recording does not say.

claims.verbatim: you went back to 2024 to delete that space
You erasing evidence is playing into my hand.

blocks.keptText: And it's happened more than once. It's happened easily over 10 times that I can prove just with our DMs alone.
blocks.rationale: Her strongest evidentiary claim, stated as something she says she can prove, not something shown.

scenes.title: Segment 3: What she says comes next, and what remains unproven
scenes.purpose: Report the legal and public steps Angela says she will take, hear the counterweights in her own words, and state clearly what the recording leaves unproven.

blocks.text: Then there is the future tense. What does Angela say happens next?

blocks.keptText: If I have to post my fucking medical chart again for the second year in a fucking row, I will. But I'm suing you bitches for damages.
blocks.rationale: Her stated plan, in her words: publication and a lawsuit.

blocks.keptText: Because then I'll flip that uno, flip reverse, and have your ass serve, file a motion for discovery, put everything on fucking record, and it will be public information. Test me. I'm not worried.
blocks.rationale: Her description of a legal response if she is challenged.

blocks.text: Two threats, then, as she tells it. A lawsuit for damages. A motion for discovery, if she is challenged. As far as this recording shows, no filing exists. She also says the threats run the other way. She says that in a voice clip and in DMs, quote, bitch, we're coming for your money bags, bitch. I have no way to check that clip from here. It is her allegation, and it is not heard in this recording.

claims.verbatim: I'm suing you bitches for damages.
And you said, and I quote, bitch, we're coming for your money bags, bitch.

blocks.keptText: And then in the future, there's going to be a lot more screenshots and recordings coming out. I'm just letting everybody play all their fucking cards first before I interact in a rebuttal.
blocks.rationale: Her stated plan to release more material.

blocks.keptText: But I was never the one that you should have been looking at. You dumb fucks. You're under investigation. You have been for a while now.
blocks.rationale: Her claim of an investigation, stated without any detail.

blocks.text: Under investigation. By whom? She does not say. No agency, no case, no date. In this recording, it is an assertion and nothing more.

To be fair, she does not present herself as beyond criticism. About a personal remark she made to Lana, she says, I should have never said that. And she says she is holding material back. She says she will hold the rest until a response. She also says questions are welcome: come and ask me. That is a reasonable offer. It is also one-sided, because nobody she accuses speaks in this recording.

claims.verbatim: I should have never said that.
I will hold the rest until your response.
you're more than welcome to come and ask me

blocks.text: So here is what remains unproven. Whether the screenshots are authentic and complete. Who sent them to her. What was said in the Space with Orr. Why the 2024 Space was deleted. Whether any lawsuit or discovery motion is ever filed. And whether any investigation exists. Angela says she has the proof. We have heard her say so. A screenshot read aloud is still a claim with a voice attached.

blocks.note: Let the bed fade after the closing line.
